title: China’s Export Engine Meets Europe’s Carbon Rules
gist: EU carbon border rules that tax carbon-intensive steel and aluminum imports and block non-compliant batteries are reshaping Chinese industry: Beijing is building zero-carbon industrial parks that hard-wire factories to renewable supply. The visible teaser argues the second-order payoff is an export opportunity in Chinese-designed industrial microgrids for emerging markets plagued by outages.

insights.so_what: Carbon intensity becomes a cost and access variable for EU-facing metals and battery supply chains — screen exporters on verified emissions, not just unit cost.
